question: PyMuPDF GIL release CPU usage during PDF text extraction

sources.title: PyMuPDF documentation
sources.snippet: PyMuPDF is a layout-aware document engine for AI and a feature-rich Python toolkit for extracting, rendering and editing PDFs and other documents. Since version 2.0, its ML-based layout analysis turns PDFs and Office files into high-quality Markdown for RAG and agents, running fast on CPU and grounding every result to its source page.
